meta.name: render-imessage-chat
meta.description: Assemble an iMessage chat-reveal video ad from a thread JSON — one continuous Playwright recording of the conversation animating in (typing dots, composer typing, bubble pops, auto-scroll) crossfaded into a designed end card, with iMessage send/receive SFX and an optional ducked music bed. FREE assembly (Playwright + ffmpeg); the recipe supplies the per-brand thread + product + end-card config and gates the paid product-image/music calls to their own capabilities. Use for the imessage-chat format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将聊天记录自动生成视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把iMessage聊天记录做成动态视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Turn chat threads into video ads automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn iMessage chat threads into dynamic video ads.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据对话 JSON 自动生成一段 iMessage 聊天视频广告：模拟打字、气泡弹出、自动滚动，最后叠加品牌尾卡，并配上音效和可选背景音乐。
howto.when: 当用户提供包含聊天记录、主题、品牌配置的 JSON 文件，并请求制作 iMessage 聊天视频广告时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这个聊天记录生成一段 iMessage 视频广告。
say.note: Claude 会读取 JSON 并开始渲染。

say.text: 把这段对话做成手机聊天视频，品牌用我的 Logo。
say.note: Claude 会调用渲染流程，生成带品牌尾卡的视频。

say.text: 给这个产品链接做一个 iMessage 聊天揭晓视频。
say.note: Claude 会处理富链接附件，生成带预览卡的视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate an iMessage chat video ad from a conversation JSON: simulate typing, bubble pops, auto-scroll, then crossfade into a branded end card with sound effects and optional background music.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a JSON file with chat history, theme, and brand config, and requests to create an iMessage chat video ad.

say_en.text: Generate an iMessage video ad from this chat JSON.
say_en.note: Claude will read the JSON and start rendering.

say_en.text: Turn this conversation into a phone chat video with my logo.
say_en.note: Claude will render the video with a branded end card.

say_en.text: Make an iMessage chat reveal video for this product link.
say_en.note: Claude will handle the rich link attachment and generate the video.
